name: Residente Temporal por Vínculo Familiar

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or common-law partner of a Costa Rican citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the spouse or common-law partner of a Costa Rican citizen.

requirement_groups.name: Child under 25 of a Costa Rican citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the child (under 25) of a Costa Rican citizen.

requirement_groups.name: Parent or minor sibling of a Costa Rican citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the parent, or a sibling under 18, of a Costa Rican citizen.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/birth certificate proving the family tie

sources.title: Navas & Navas -- Categorías Migratorias summary (vínculo familiar category)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. This is the general 'family ties' temporary residence category (distinct from cr_naturalisation_marriage, which is the CITIZENSHIP track available to a spouse who has already held this kind of residence for the required 2 years). citizenship_after_months (24) reflects the spouse group specifically feeding cr_naturalisation_marriage's 2-year track; the child/parent/sibling groups instead feed the general permanent-residence and standard-naturalisation tracks.
